author: Edward Penny
text: Sometimes the sensors are funky and fail. If you contact Abbot they’ll send you a replacement free of charge.

author: Wendy Mohi
text: I also had a faulty libre 2 sensor with 9 days still to go.  Took copies of the errors and sent it through to their address but was told they don’t make the sensors and to contact the manufacturer in Australia.  Have yet to hear back.  Ive now changed to linx.
